Bitcoin treasury can change a company’s index status. 📊

MSCI is reviewing new eligibility rules for so-called non-operating companies.

The proposal is not aimed specifically at crypto firms, but under the current methodology, companies like Strategy and Metaplanet could potentially be affected.

The key issue is not what asset a company holds.

It is how much of the company still looks like an operating business.

MSCI is looking at factors such as:

• operating assets
• operating expenses
• cash flow
• fair-value impact
• reliance on external capital

If a company mainly accumulates assets, generates limited operating activity and repeatedly raises capital to buy more, it can start to look more like an investment vehicle than a traditional business.

⚡ For Bitcoin treasury companies, that creates a new type of risk.

The question is no longer only:

“How much Bitcoin can the company accumulate?”

It is also:

“What happens if that strategy changes how the market classifies the company?”

Crypto strategy can reshape more than a balance sheet.

It can reshape a company’s place inside traditional finance.
